subject: Evening ML screen: candidate cascade + run-of-show and debrief plan
thread_body:
From: Olivia Tran <olivia@talentworks.io>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate: Eleanor Park — availability for evening ML screen

Hi Diego / Kimberly,

Quick note: Eleanor (attached resume) requested an evening slot on July 15 because she is relocating this week and will be available later PST. She can do 7:00–8:15pm PT. Can we confirm an interviewer panel for that time and a brief debrief doc so Marissa can take notes?

Panel ask: 1x ML engineer (modeling), 1x infra/platform (runtime/cost), 1x hiring debrief lead.

Candidate info: senior ML engineer, background in quantization/serving, currently at Acme Commerce — resume attached (Eleanor_Park_resume_v2.pdf).

Thanks,
Olivia
TalentWorks / Recruiting Partner

----
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate: Eleanor Park — availability for evening ML screen

Thanks, Olivia — and hi team.

Kimberly: can you take modeling (system design / modeling trade-offs)? Priyom: platform/runtime questions — would you be available 7:00–8:15pm PT tomorrow (Tue 7/15)? Marissa, please accept and I'll hand the debrief to you.

Logistics we need: Zoom link, CoderPad link (or internal take-home), shared debrief doc (drive), and confirmation about recordings/consent. Candidate prefers no recording but is ok with notes.

If anyone needs to swap out, call it out now so we can roster backup.

— Diego
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

----
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olivia Tran <olivia@talentworks.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 17:10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate: Eleanor Park — availability for evening ML screen

All set on my side — I can do the 7pm slot. I created the session links and an anchor debrief doc:
- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (host: kimberly_park@redwood.com)
- CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/sessions/rdwd-ml-screen-epk-20250715
- Debrief (drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1-debrief-template (redwood_debrief_template.docx)

Notes / run-of-show (short):
1) 7:00–7:05 PM — quick intros and expectations (Diego)
2) 7:05–7:45 PM — coding + systems exercise on CoderPad (Kimberly leads, candidate codes)
3) 7:45–8:05 PM — follow-up system questions + quantization/latency tradeoffs (Priyom leads)
4) 8:05–8:15 PM — immediate 5-min impressions + next steps (Marissa to run debrief)

Attachments: I uploaded candidate resume and a lightweight NDA stub the candidate previously signed (for records) to the drive folder.

If we need a backup for Priyom, Marissa can moderate the platform questions or I can cover them briefly.

Kimberly
Senior Staff ML Engineer

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Tran <olivia@talentworks.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 19:02:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate: Eleanor Park — availability for evening ML screen

Confirmed — I accepted the calendar invite and opened the debrief doc. Two quick asks:
- Can we have the scoring rubric at the top of the debrief (I added a short template, but please add any role-specific bullets)?
- Candidate consent on recording: Olivia said candidate prefers notes only; I've added a line in the doc for "consent: notes only".

I'll take the 8:05–8:15 wrap and capture action items (hiring committee verdict, recommended level, compensation band to propose).

Marissa Cole
Hiring Lead, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:22:11 -0700

Thanks for the quick turn. Eleanor confirmed this morning and re-sent an updated resume (attached: Eleanor_Park_resume_v2.pdf). She reiterated she does not want the session recorded and is fine with panel notes. She also asked if there's a short doc she should read before the screen (e.g., example problems).

I suggested a brief read: the role one-pager (I linked the job posting) and said the interview is mostly a systems/coding conversation.

I'll stand by on the day-of coordination; if anything changes I will let you know immediately.

Olivia
TalentWorks
